question: There were 12 boys who got trapped in a cave in June 2018. A huge exercise had to be carried to rescue them. It became an internationally famous incident. Which country did this incident happen in?
solution:
The Correct answer is Thailand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** In June and July 2018**, a **junior association football team **was rescued from **Tham Luang Nang Non, a cave system in Chiang Rai province, northern Thailand**.
 
• **Twelve members of the team, aged 11 to 16**, and their **25-year-old assistant coach** entered the cave on 23 June after a practice session.
 
• Shortly after they entered, heavy rainfall began and partially flooded the cave system, blocking their way out and trapping them deep within.
